# Templates are re-parsed to locate their actions, and text/template/parse
# rejects a call to a function it was not given. The builtins -- eq, and,
# index, len and the rest -- have to be among them, or any template using
# one fails to enumerate.
#
# TestStatus only renders a code of 200, so forcing the condition true
# changes nothing it sees and that mutant survives. Forcing it false swaps
# the branch and is caught.

muxt test-template-mutations
cmp stdout want.txt

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "status"}}{{if eq .Code 200}}ok{{else}}bad{{end}}{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Status struct {
	Code int
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestStatus(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := templates.ExecuteTemplate(&buf, "status", Status{Code: 200}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "ok"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("status = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
-- want.txt --
baseline ok
KILL templates.gohtml:1:20 "status" if-false
MISS templates.gohtml:1:20 "status" if-true
2 mutants, 1 killed, 1 missed
